item.text: The scanner currently reads the global `c.Conf.WpIgnoreInactive`, while the server-specific setting is `ServerInfo.WordPress.IgnoreInactive`. The cache is also a pointer-to-map; I’m changing it to a map of string pointers so a present key with a nil value can be handled as the required cache miss.
